issues.description: The template's ArrayHelpers class defines a method named appendElement(T[], T) but the Stock class in the template calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This name mismatch causes a compile-time error and prevents students from building or running the project. The solution repository uses addElementToArray, indicating the intended helper name differs from the template's provided method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method name consistent in the template. Either rename ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) (matching Stock and the solution) or update Stock.addToStockIngredients to call ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...). Preferably update ArrayHelpers in the template to provide addElementToArray (or add a forwarding method) so examples and solution names align.

issues.description: The helper method used to append an element to an array is referenced with different identifiers across artifacts. The template's ArrayHelpers defines appendElement(...) but Stock.java (template) calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). The solution defines addElementToArray(...). This mismatch (appendElement vs addElementToArray) causes a compile/runtime mismatch in the template and creates confusion about which helper name students should use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the append method name consistent across all artifacts. Rename the method in the template ArrayHelpers from appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) (matching the solution and the usage in Stock.java), or adjust Stock.java to call appendElement(...). Prefer aligning to addElementToArray(...) to match the solution and comments in other files.
